source_note: 以Redpipe2012年原物实拍为主，去掉周围现代保护亭和铁围栏。实拍下部受围栏遮挡，简化莲瓣柱础与石基轮廓依据中国古迹遗址保护协会学习资料；不复刻铭文文字，非测绘复原。旧国保公布的易县所在地与现定兴行政区划分别记录。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one architectural heritage illustration for 访古. Image 1 is ONLY the STYLE MASTER, the existing Vairocana contour drawing. Image 2 and any further images are actual monument photographs and ONLY define subject geometry. Match the master's delicate, slightly organic thin black contours, sparse interior strokes, generous white surfaces and restrained visual density. Pure BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. No black fills, shading, gray wash, hatching, pencil texture, dense brick or tile grids, color, text, labels, watermark or borders. Structural bays, eaves and silhouette must match the real monument. Reduce repetitive detail; do not trace every roof tile or brick. Openings stay white inside fine outlines. Complete apex and full base uncut, generous margins, centered near-frontal, reduced perspective. Remove tourists, trees, vegetation, fences, wires, vehicles, signs and surrounding modern structures. Ground consists of a few thin strokes. SUBJECT: Yicihui stone pillar, the actual Northern Qi 562 CE monument at Shizhu village, Dingxing, Hebei. Portrait 1024x1536. Draw ONLY the ancient stone object in image 2, NOT the large modern protective pavilion surrounding it. The monument is one very tall plain chamfered square/octagonal stone shaft, a slightly wider rectangular tablet-like upper front strip integrated into the shaft, a broad thick square stone plate at the top, and on that plate a TINY ancient three-bay stone-house model with a single low hipped roof and small stone bracket/eave carvings. The little stone house is only about one seventh of the total height. This is not an ordinary multi-storey pagoda. Preserve the ancient worn, slightly chipped stone contours; do not rebuild it as fresh perfect masonry. Lower shaft stands on a modest worn lotus-shaped stone footing and simple block foundation; keep it understated and show the whole outline to the ground after removing the obstructing fence. Reframe from the photograph's steep low angle to a distant near-frontal view with slight side reveal so shaft, plate, stone house and full roof are legible. No artificial monument plinth, no decorative staircase. Do not copy the gigantic surrounding pavilion roof, red columns, metal fence, trees or signs. Omit all carved inscription letters while retaining the outlined inscription panel division. Very sparse delicate black linework, blank white shaft, only a handful of carving and crack contours. The tiny ancient stone house, projecting plate and long shaft must remain distinct and accurately proportioned.

site_recommendation.name: 义慈惠石柱
site_recommendation.sub: 北齐石柱及柱顶三间石殿
site_recommendation.yearNote: 现址定兴县高里乡石柱村；旧国保所在地易县是旧行政标注。北魏木柱前身与北齐石构分开。
site_recommendation.lede: 义慈惠石柱以一根高大的石柱托起小小石殿，石上仿木构留下北齐建筑的细节。柱身长篇颂文讲述乱世中的义葬与救济，也使这座纪念物有了名字。

facts.label: 年代
facts.text: 现存石构立于北齐大宁二年（562），更早的木柱前身属于北魏时期。

facts.label: 形制
facts.text: 柱身上承石盘和三间石屋，屋顶、檐椽、斗栱等均以石雕表现。

facts.label: 铭刻
facts.text: 柱颂记录北魏末年战乱及义葬、义食经过；原物在定兴石柱村。

quality_check.notes: 单根石柱、方盘和小石屋清晰，未把现代保护亭画进来；石材风化断裂适当保留。
